messages:
jen: Heads up — got an alert in #incidents for infra/gpu-queue but the thread has no PagerDuty link. Oncall didn't get paged. Anyone else seeing missing PD metadata?

devops-bot: alert_id=8421 routed to notify-proxy; upstream webhook responded 500 
```
ERROR notify-proxy: failed to sign webhook: missing HMAC header
stack: http-signing -> header-check
```

max: I didn't receive a page. Only saw this slack thread. PD shows no incident created for 8421.

amanda: Looking at notify-proxy logs — signing header dropped after the last deploy. It looks like the new config made the header optional and our header-strip middleware removed it when empty. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by sam: notify-proxy v1.3.4 -> v1.3.5 (config change: header-signing=optional)

sam: Yep, that was my change to make signing optional while testing. Rolling back immediately. Sorry all.

amanda: Rollback completed. notify-proxy back to v1.3.4 and signing enforced. Can someone requeue the alert?

jen: Requeueing now: `/alert requeue 8421`

pagerbridge-bot: Requeued alert 8421 -> created PD incident PD-7890 and dispatched page to oncall :thumbsup:

max: Got the page now and I'm acknowledging. Thanks. Any customer impact?

jen: Possible. We saw a small spike of failed inference calls around 2026-03-16T12:34Z (2 customer orgs affected). I'm pulling logs for error traces.

mat: Triage update: TF-serving upstream returned 503s during the window — seems like the notify-proxy failures coincided with cert-renewer expiring, causing transient auth failures and the 5xx surge. Metrics: error-rate went to 7% for ~90s.

jen: Oof. Mitigation in progress — restarting cert-renewer and redeploying the small auth patch.

amanda: Mitigation applied. Error rate back to baseline (~0.2%). Support, please prep outreach for impacted customers.

sarah-support: Support notified and creating tickets for the two affected accounts. No P1 escalation required, but customers will be informed.

amanda: Root cause: my rollback analysis — the optional-signing flag in v1.3.5 allowed header to be absent; our intermediate proxy strips empty headers which prevented PD webhook from matching signature -> PD creation failed. We'll add a unit test to prevent headers being dropped and prevent making signing optional.

jen: Also adding a runbook step: any change to webhook signing must go through an integration test that validates PD creation. I'll start the postmortem doc.

max: Thanks for the quick rollback and requeue. Reacting :eyes: to the postmortem when ready.

amanda: Adding follow-ups: (1) Add tests, (2) Add alert that detects missing PD metadata on routing, (3) Postmortem + lessons.

jen: Closing the incident thread here, moving to postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast coordination. :thumbsup:
